name: Blueprint for Engine Evolution
description: Defines how NeoEngine v1 should evolve into v2, including new modules and capabilities.
author: NeoEngine v1 (Self-Analysis)

recommended_modules.name: AdvancedPathfindingModule
recommended_modules.description: Implements A* and Flow Field pathfinding for large, dynamic worlds.

recommended_modules.name: ProceduralTerrainModule
recommended_modules.description: Generates seamless, infinite terrain based on biome definitions.

recommended_modules.name: AdvancedAICombatModule
recommended_modules.description: Adds tactical AI for group combat and strategic decision making.

new_agents.name: PerformanceAgent
new_agents.description: Monitors and optimizes game performance (FPS, memory, draw calls) in real-time.

new_agents.name: ScaleAgent
new_agents.description: Manages game scaling for different platforms (mobile, desktop, console).

importer_extensions.name: AudioConverter
importer_extensions.description: Converts audio manifest entries into Godot AudioStreamPlayer nodes and resources.

importer_extensions.name: UIConverter
importer_extensions.description: Converts UI layout definitions into Godot Control scenes.

engine_v2_capabilities: Support for 1000+ concurrent players in a single world instance
Real-time procedural generation of entire continents
AI-driven dynamic narrative that adapts to thousands of players simultaneously
Integrated debugging and profiling tools accessible via in-game commands
Automated testing framework for generated content

changes: Improved performance of WorldConverter for large regions
Added new IAP product types in MonetizationAgent
